## Video Processor (FFmpeg Self-Hosted)

### Requires:
- FFmpeg installed in n8n container
- Sufficient disk space for temp files
- Write access to /data/chakra9/outputs

### Input (POST /process-video):
```json
{
  "yacht_id": "spysea",
  "source_file_id": "drive_file_id",
  "clips": [
    { "clip_id": "01", "start_sec": 0, "end_sec": 30 }
  ],
  "vertical": true,
  "overlays": [
    { "text": "Hook text", "style": "bold" }
  ]
}
```

### Output:
- Vertical MP4 clips (1080x1920)
- Text overlays burned in
- Files in /data/chakra9/outputs/{yacht_id}/
